answer: 동일 tree와 현재 review 상태가 입증되면 재사용 (권장)
meaning: Retain independent review and permit reuse across final commit SHAs only when reviewed source-tree equality, an explicit successor binding to the new commit, current review state and absence of unresolved findings are proven. A changed tree or unresolved finding requires new review.

selectionContext.text: 독립 review는 유지하되, final commit SHA가 달라도 reviewed source tree가 동일하다는 증명과 새 commit 연결 기록이 있고 미해결 finding이 없으면 기존 review를 재사용할까요? tree가 달라지거나 finding이 남으면 새 review가 필요합니다.
